title: Minimum Cost Path With At Most K Turns
summary: Find a minimum-cost four-direction path from the top-left to the bottom-right of grid using at most k turns. A turn changes movement direction between consecutive moves; the first move is not a turn. Pay the value of every visited cell, including both endpoints and repeated visits. Return the minimum total, or -1 if impossible.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
